> [!CAUTION]
> **Do not report critical or active security vulnerabilities publicly in GitHub Issues.**
> Public disclosure exposes user funds and private keys before a patch can be deployed.

## Responsible Disclosure

If you have discovered a security vulnerability in Nodal AI (such as smart contract escrow drain, key leakage, replay vulnerability, or bypass in x402 payment verification):

1. Please read our **[Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md)** for our full disclosure process and PGP encryption keys.
2. Submit your report privately to the maintainers at **security@nodal-ai.io** or via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/Nodal-stellar/Nodal-AI/security/advisories/new).
3. Provide a detailed proof of concept, affected versions, and steps to reproduce.
